educationalGoal:
For students studying at KIT, "Company" is and will be closely related.
It is important for them to understand the basic knowledge of "Company" such as "Organization" and "Management Strategy", and to pay intellectual attention to "Cpmpany" activities.
The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the basic knowledge of "Company" through various case stduies.
advice:

5. Business diversification
